glossdef.p:
A cybersecurity incident may include any of the following:
Unauthorized disclosure or alteration of private data (e.g., employee evaluations, social security numbers, certain research data
Loss or theft of computers or media that contains private data
Inappropriate content on an NC State web page, such as advertising for a noneducational commercial product or pornographic material
Distribution of viruses or malicious software from a device or computer on the NC State network
Criminal activity conducted via computers
